name: ocr_read
description: Extract text from an image file (PNG, JPG, etc.) using OCR and return it as a string. Use this to read text that appears inside a picture or screenshot.

path.description: Path to the image file to read text from.

languages.description: Language codes to recognize, e.g. ["en"] or ["en","fr"]. Defaults to ["en"].

detail.description: If true, also return each detected text box with its bounding box and confidence. Defaults to false (plain text only).
